SOLARZED — CLIENT DESIGN PRESENTATION

Open index.html in your browser. No installation or database is needed to review this design.

Pages:
1. Home
2. Dealer warranty registration
3. Warranty lookup
4. Warranty guide
5. Contact & support

Style: white, turquoise and navy. English content. Responsive desktop and mobile layouts.

In this offline presentation, forms are demonstrations only. No registration is saved and no SMS or support message is sent. Use “Try a sample record” on the lookup page to see the confirmation design.

Items for brand approval: final logo, licensed vehicle photograph, official warranty policy, phone number and email. The vehicle image is a reference placeholder from the earlier Sun Vision inspired concept.
